layout4aa.illustrationType: Top-view mechanical assembly layout; true vector, transparent, no embedded raster

Front-facing HC-SR04 is represented as a flattened front-view sprite; true 3D top view would show sensor board edge
Switch is shown at one existing PDF slot, but photograph does not determine its real attachment
4AA variant fits on plate under adopted AA size calibration
